64: Rabbi Shimon said: Adam separated from his wife for 130 years. During all of those years, he produced spirits and demons in the world on account of that power of impurity that he had absorbed into himself. Once that impurity had left him, he went back and became jealous for his wife, and he fathered a son [from her]. Hence it is written: and he produced [a son] in his likeness according to his image (Genesis 5:3).
